liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **The Gold Rush**: rare: 10 archived performances [8]
- **My Sweet Blue-eyed Darlin'**: back after 144 archived shows (1002 days) [8]
- **Hallow Heart**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **Shenandoah Breakdown**: rare: 6 archived performances [8]
- **Born To Be With You**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [8]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2022-05-14.mbhoka500** (recommended): source not stated; 27 songs; 161 min [1]
- **billystrings2022-05-14.InsideOut_AKG568**: source not stated; 23 songs; 156 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this recording excellent and thinks it may be the best of the three Colorado nights taped [5]
- **billystrings2022-05-14.InsideOut_AKGck63**: source not stated; 23 songs; 156 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **billystrings2022-05-14.InsideOut_Mix_akg568.ck63**: source not stated; 23 songs; 156 min [4]

## Around the show

- Taped from the back-of-board floor area, row D, eight feet high, about 80 feet from the stage [1]
- The taper credits Billy Strings' crew for hospitality toward tapers and praises the Mission Ballroom for being accommodating [2]
- Taper captured all three Colorado shows on this run; the reviewer ranks this night possibly the best recording of the three [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2022-05-14.mbhoka500**: taped by Rob O'Brien; transferred by Rob O'Brien; source: MBHO KA500 (DINa) > 603 MBP > Sound Devices MixPre-6 MKII(24/96) [1]. Also: Transferred from SDHC to PC, edited in Wave Lab 6.1, tracked in CD Wave, and encoded with TLH [1]
- **billystrings2022-05-14.InsideOut_AKG568**: taped by HealthCov Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recordings; source: AKG 568 > SD MixPre-10ii [2]. Also: Captured with AKG 568 mics through GaKables into a Sound Devices MixPre-10ii; pulled and processed by Chris of InsideOut Recording [2]
- **billystrings2022-05-14.InsideOut_AKGck63**: taped by HealthCov Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: AKG ck63 (PAS) > SD MixPre-10ii [3]. Also: Captured with AKG ck63 mics through Nbob actives and a Naiant PFA into a MixPre-10ii; processed by Chris of InsideOut Recording [3]
- **billystrings2022-05-14.InsideOut_Mix_akg568.ck63**: taped by HealthCov Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recordings; source: AKG 568 + AKG ck63 > SD MixPre-10ii [4]. Also: Mix of two sources: AKG 568 in PAS configuration and AKG ck63 in DINa through Nbob actives and Naiant PFA, both to MixPre-10ii [4]
